prompts.text: factory_dispatch-style prompt for GardnerTimingRecovery; isolated worktree; verify vs GR or quarantine.

quarantine_reason: Q15 Gardner TED (>>1 halving to fit int16) jitters too hard to lock the matched-filter Nyquist channel where GR symbol_sync_cc(Gardner) is BER 0; DUT BER ~4-12%. MMTimingRecovery is the verified alternative.
notes: QUARANTINE (needs_human), 2 attempts, autonomous verdict. poc. KEY FINDING: the block's OLD 'green' tests validated against a synthetic 2sps stimulus GR ITSELF cannot lock (BER ~0.45) -- i.e. it was tuned outside GR's operating regime; per-block GR-equivalence exposed it. New test PROVES both sides on the same channel (GR locks BER 0; DUT does not, reference AND on-chip) + leaves an xfail tripwire to promote if ever fixed. Extends the documented Gardner 4-PAM limit to 2-level BPSK on a Nyquist channel. A paper data point, not a hidden failure.
